title: Connexin46 in the nucleus of cancer cells: a possible role as transcription modulator.
authors: Fernandez-Olivares, Ainoa; Orellana, Viviana P; Llanquinao, Jesus; Nunez, Gonzalo; Perez-Moreno, Pablo; Contreras-Riquelme, Sebastian; Martin, Alberto Jm; Mammano, Fabio; Alfaro, Ivan E; Calderon, Juan F; Stehberg, Jimmy; Saez, Mauricio A; Retamal, Mauricio A
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过ChIP-Seq和分子动力学模拟揭示核内Cx46/GJA3-30k作为转录调节因子与DNA结合并激活致癌通路，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作机制及MD方法对TF-DNA研究有借鉴价值。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Oncogenes drive cancer progression, but few are active exclusively in tumor cells. Connexins (Cxs), traditionally recognized as ion channel proteins, can localize to the nucleus and regulate gene expression, playing key roles in both physiological and pathological processes. Cx46, once thought to be restricted to the eye lens, has been implicated in tumor growth, though its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigates the nuclear presence of Cx46 in cancer cells and its potential role as a transcriptional modulator. METHODS: We employed ChIP-Seq, confocal immunofluorescence, and nuclear protein purification to assess Cx46 localization and DNA interactions. Functional assays were conducted to evaluate its effects on invasion, division, spheroid formation, and mesenchymal marker expression. Single-point mutations and molecular dynamics simulations were used to explore potential Cx46-DNA interactions. RESULTS: Cx46 mRNA upregulation was found in a variety of tumors compared to adjacent healthy tissue. In HeLa cells, which do not express Cx46, its transfection promoted proliferation, invasion and self-renewal capacity, cancer stem cell traits and mesenchymal features. Consistently, in Sk-Mel-2, which naturally express Cx46, reduced Cx46 expression led to a decrease in the similar parameters. In HeLa cells, nuclear Cx46 was detected in two forms, full length 46 kDa and a 30 kDa fragment (GJA3-30 k), ChIP-Seq experiments revealed that Cx46 binds to the DNA at intergenic and promoter regions, leading to the activation of oncogenic pathways. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest that GJA3-30 k dimerizes in a RAD50-like structure, forming stable DNA complexes. Cx46 and in some cases GJA3-30 k were detected in the nuclei of multiple cancer cell lines, including prostate, breast and skin cancers. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings reveal a novel nuclear role for Cx46 in cancer, demonstrating its function as a transcriptional regulator and its potential as a therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 背景：癌基因驱动癌症进展，但很少有基因仅在肿瘤细胞中活跃。连接蛋白（Connexins, Cxs）传统上被视为离子通道蛋白，可定位于细胞核并调控基因表达，在生理和病理过程中发挥关键作用。Cx46曾被认为仅限于眼晶状体，现已被涉及肿瘤生长，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。本研究探讨Cx46在癌细胞中的核定位及其作为转录调节因子的潜在作用。方法：我们采用ChIP-Seq、共聚焦免疫荧光和核蛋白纯化来评估Cx46的定位和DNA相互作用。通过功能实验评估其对侵袭、分裂、球体形成和间充质标志物表达的影响。使用单点突变和分子动力学模拟来探索Cx46-DNA的潜在相互作用。结果：与邻近健康组织相比，多种肿瘤中Cx46 mRNA表达上调。在不表达Cx46的HeLa细胞中，其转染促进了增殖、侵袭和自我更新能力、癌症干细胞特征及间充质特征。一致地，在天然表达Cx46的Sk-Mel-2细胞中，Cx46表达减少导致类似参数下降。在HeLa细胞中，核内Cx46以两种形式检测到：全长46 kDa和30 kDa片段（GJA3-30 k）。ChIP-Seq实验显示，Cx46结合到基因间区和启动子区域的DNA上，导致致癌通路激活。分子动力学模拟提示，GJA3-30 k以RAD50样结构二聚化，形成稳定的DNA复合物。在多种癌细胞系（包括前列腺癌、乳腺癌和皮肤癌）的细胞核中检测到Cx46，部分情况下也检测到GJA3-30 k。结论：我们的发现揭示了Cx46在癌症中的新型核内作用，证明其作为转录调节因子的功能及其作为治疗靶点的潜力。
